name: prism-pact
description: Prism Pact — match-3 PvP with live draft, on Avalanche

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace shared && npm run test --workspace contracts && npm run test --workspace server

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace contracts && npm --prefix client run build
